title: GitHub Releases API: fields read by the Kinolune updater
description: Subset of GET https://api.github.com/repos/DenisHumen/kinolune/releases?per_page=30 that the full-flavor updater reads (PKG-018/PKG-022; clients/flutter/app/lib/features/updates/releases.dart, AppRelease.fromGitHub). The list also holds releases with other tags; the app keeps only non-draft releases whose tag_name is app-v followed by a semver. Other GitHub fields are allowed. CI stand-in: packaging/app/update-test/release-json.py.

name.description: Title; 'debug-signed' marks APKs signed with the CI debug key.

prerelease.description: A semver pre-release version counts as a pre-release even if this is false.

body.description: Release notes (Markdown); the changelog is the part before '## Downloads'.

name.description: An installable app release carries SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.minisig.
